name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: This quest represents a pivotal step in restoring Dartol's Rod of Transformation, an ancient night elf artifact being sought by Raene Wolfrunner. Guided by Shael'dryn at her moonwell, adventurers must venture north toward the foul border of Felwood to recover an iron shaft locked inside a hidden chest. The mission carries a tragic undertone, forcing the Alliance to confront corrupted ancients who guard the key.

sections.title: A Fragment Near the Blight
sections.body: Following the clues to repair Dartol's Rod, Raene directs the search to Shael'dryn, a knowledgeable keeper watching over a tranquil moonwell deep in Ashenvale. Shael'dryn knows the whereabouts of the rod's iron shaft, yet retrieving it requires confronting the creeping taint threatening the northern woods. The piece lies locked in an old chest tucked away in a quiet glade near the border of Felwood.

sections.title: The Fallen Guardians
sections.body: Reaching the chest requires a wooden key, but the key itself has fallen into the hands of the forest's warped protectors. Along the mountain road running north toward Felwood, treants known as Crazed and Withered Ancients wander in agony. The corruption leaching southward from the demonic wastes has shattered their natural harmony, turning former stewards of the wild into hostile, tormented creatures that must be subdued to reclaim Dartol's relic.

faq.answer: Shael'dryn is a night elf keeper stationed at a secluded moonwell in Ashenvale, east of Astranaar and south of the Felwood road. She possesses deep knowledge of the forest's history and Dartol's ancient craft, offering quiet counsel to those trying to mend the rod.

The treants dwell along the northern ridges adjoining Felwood. The pervasive demonic taint lingering from the Third War continues to bleed southward into Ashenvale, warping the trees, driving the ancient protectors insane, and twisting their natural connection to the land.

Dartol's Rod is an enchanted relic crafted long ago by a night elf named Dartol. Once fully assembled and purified, it carries strong transformative magic capable of disguising the bearer as a furbolg, making it vital to Raene's plans for investigating the local tribes.

faq.q: Where is the hidden chest located?
faq.answer: The worn chest containing the iron shaft rests in a small, quiet glade just west of the mountain road that climbs north out of Ashenvale toward the Felwood border.

faq.q: Why does Shael'dryn mourn the treants?
faq.answer: Treants are timeless caretakers of the Kaldorei forests, revered as sacred spirits of nature. Watching them fall to madness and corruption without any known cure pains Shael'dryn deeply, as putting them down is an act of sorrow rather than malice.

faq.q: How does this task fit into the wider cleansing chain?
faq.answer: It serves as the stage where the physical components of Dartol's broken rod are assembled. Once the iron shaft and other pieces are gathered, the effort shifts toward purifying the rod's lingering magical power.

angles.text: Putting down the Crazed Ancients is an agonizing duty, as these living trees were once beloved companions and forest wardens before the demonic blight poisoned their spirits.
Seeing the ancients driven to madness by Felwood's encroaching taint is a grim reminder of the Emerald Dream's struggle to heal the wounded surface world.
Rebuilding Dartol's relic is essential to securing the road network in northern Ashenvale against rising hostilities from corrupted furbolgs and demonic forces.
